Wow what are the fabric pots like? I have only a patio!

You will find them online listed as fabric pots, smart pots, grow bags, and aeration pots. They are different from hard sided planters in that when a root hits the side of the pot it meets air and quits growing rather than wrapping along the inside of the container. This causes more root growth within the interior of the pot. Excess water runs out the sides and bottom.

In pro vs con, the only con I would have against them is that you have to be vigilant about watering. They dry out quicker in hot weather more than a hard sided pot. They really can't be over watered if mother nature decides it's time to flood your plants with heavy rains.
